mapper.insert: insert into gym.seckill_activity (card_id, card_name, original_price, seckill_price, total_stock, available_stock, start_time, end_time, status) value (#{cardId},#{cardName},#{originalPrice},#{seckillPrice},#{totalStock},#{availableStock},#{startTime},#{endTime},#{status})
mapper.update: update gym.seckill_activity set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update gym.seckill_activity set available_stock = available_stock -1 where id = #{activityId}
update gym.seckill_activity set available_stock = available_stock +1 where id = #{activityId}
